buzzers.title: Buzzers
buzzers.desksCountHint: 4 by default, 6 at most. The backoffice only offers these desks when launching a game. Buzzers and lights of removed desks are kept in reserve, inactive, and come back if you raise the number again.
buzzers.simulation: No buzzer paired: the simulation keyboard is used (one row of keys per desk: 1-4, Q-R, A-F, Z-V, then 5-8 and T-I).
buzzers.inactive: The page lost focus: buzzers are not received. Click the page to enable them again.
buzzers.learnHint: Each buzzer is requested, desk by desk: press it to pair it.
buzzers.resetConfirm: Forget the paired buzzers, including those kept in reserve for removed desks, and use the simulation keyboard?
buzzers.duplicate: Key {key} is already used by buzzer {button} on desk {desk}.
buzzers.forbidden: Key {key} is reserved by the system and cannot be a buzzer.
buzzers.testHint: Press a buzzer: it lights up here.

lights.title: Lights
lights.simulated: Simulated room: lights are shown below.
lights.connectFailed: Could not open the DMX interface. Check the USB cable and try again.
lights.bridgeDown: Art-Net bridge not connected: lights stay simulated and smoke stays off.
lights.noWebSerial: This browser cannot drive USB: use Chrome or Edge.
lights.simulationDriver: Pick a DMX interface in the advanced settings to drive real lights.
lights.emergencyActive: Emergency stop active: lights off, smoke cut.
lights.emergencyResetConfirm: Turn the lights back on? Check the room is safe first. Smoke stays disarmed.
lights.physicalStop: The software button does not replace the physical emergency stop required in the room.
lights.noFixtures: No fixture declared. Add them in the advanced settings.

warnings.smoke_refused: Smoke refused by the safety rules.
warnings.watchdog: The page froze: smoke cut for safety.
warnings.page_hidden: Tab hidden: smoke cut for safety.
warnings.output_recovered: The DMX interface responds again: lights resumed (smoke still off).

smoke.title: Smoke
smoke.disabled: Smoke is disabled in the room settings.
smoke.armHint: To be ticked by the operator once the room is checked. Smoke is disarmed by every emergency stop.

refused.cooldown: Safety pause, try again in a few seconds.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.hint: Full room configuration (JSON): DMX interface, fixtures, desk colours, smoke safety. See the hardware documentation.

diagnostic.title: Hardware diagnostics
diagnostic.hint: Test the DMX interface, each channel and each fixture. Game scenes are paused during diagnostics.
diagnostic.allowUnknown: Allow channels outside declared fixtures (address search)
diagnostic.unplugSmoke: Unplug the smoke machine first: its real address may be one of these channels.
diagnostic.activeHint: Diagnostics running. They stop on their own after 10 minutes without action.
diagnostic.freezeHint: Simulates a crash: a short smoke burst, then no frames at all for 15 s. The timed relay must cut the smoke on its own, within 10 s. Do it in an empty room, with the physical emergency stop within reach.
diagnostic.freezeConfirm1: Smoke will really be released. Is the room empty and the physical emergency stop within reach?
diagnostic.freezeConfirm2: Last confirmation: no frames will be sent for 15 s. If the smoke does not stop on its own, press the physical emergency stop.
diagnostic.frozen: No frames sent: {n} s left. The smoke must have stopped on its own.

refused.smoke_channel: Smoke channel: smoke is only tested with the safe test button.
refused.unknown_channel: This channel belongs to no declared fixture. Tick address search to test it.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot drive USB: use Chrome or Edge.
errors.busy: The interface is already used by another program.
errors.forbidden: The browser denied access to the interface.
errors.unknown: Could not open the DMX interface.

diagnostic.freezeBridge: With the Art-Net bridge, the bridge itself cuts the smoke when the browser goes quiet: this test would not check the timed relay. Run it with the USB interface, or stop the bridge program during a burst.
diagnostic.freezeNoInterface: Connect the real DMX interface first: in simulation no smoke would come out and the test would prove nothing.

browser.title: Check the browser
browser.hint: USB DMX interfaces only work in Chrome or Edge, on a secure page.

buzzers.title: Pair the buzzers
buzzers.hint: Set the number of desks and the buzzer box type, then press each buzzer when asked.

interface.title: Choose the DMX interface
interface.hint: The interface links the PC to the lights. Without one, the room is simulated on screen.

fixtures.title: Declare the fixtures
fixtures.hint: Add each light. The address is the one set on the fixture (display or DIP switches): the first free one is suggested.

fixtureTest.title: Test each fixture
fixtureTest.hint: Turn each fixture on: if it lights up, it works. Otherwise check its address and the DMX cable.

positions.title: Aim at the desks
positions.hint: For each moving head, move the beam until it lights the given desk.

smoke.title: Secure the smoke
smoke.hint: Smoke is only enabled once every check below is done.

summary.title: Summary
summary.hint: Check the points below, then save the room configuration.

buzzers.gamepadWake: Press a buzzer to activate the board: the browser only sees it after a first press.

interface.experimental: Open DMX is experimental: the PC generates the signal, flicker is possible. Prefer a DMX USB Pro interface.

about.simulation: No hardware: lights are shown on screen. Ideal to try things out.
about.usbpro: Interface with its own processor (Enttec DMX USB Pro and compatibles): stable signal.
about.opendmx: Simple USB-DMX cable (FTDI) without a processor: cheap, less reliable.
about.artnet-bridge: quizzup-artnet-bridge program running on the PC: drives an Art-Net node (e.g. Showtec NET-2/3) on the network.

interface.bridge: Start the quizzup-artnet-bridge program on this PC first (see its guide). Chrome may ask for local network access: allow it.
interface.artnetTargetHint: Address of the Art-Net box on the room network (e.g. 192.168.1.50), or a broadcast address (e.g. 192.168.1.255). Local networks only. It is sent to the bridge on every connection.
interface.artnetInvalid: Address refused: enter an IPv4 from a local network (10.x.x.x, 172.16 to 31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, 169.254.x.x or 127.x.x.x).

artnetSource.cli: forced by the bridge command line
artnetSource.none: no target: enter the node IP

interface.artnetOldBridge: This bridge is too old to receive the IP from the room screen: update it, or start it with --target.
interface.artnetCliWins: The bridge was started with --target: that address takes priority and the field above is ignored.
interface.artnetSearchOffline: Connect the bridge first (button below) to search for nodes.
interface.artnetSearchOld: This bridge is too old to search for nodes: update it, or enter the IP by hand.

artnetSearchError.not_connected: Search failed: the bridge is not (or no longer) connected. Reconnect it and search again.
artnetSearchError.unsupported: Search failed: this bridge is too old, update it or enter the IP by hand.
artnetSearchError.timeout: The bridge did not answer the search. Check that it is still running, then try again.
artnetSearchError.poll_failed: The bridge could not query the network (cable, network card or broadcast address?). The connection stays open: fix it and try again.
artnetSearchError.unknown: Search failed for an unknown reason.

interface.artnetNoNode: No node found. Check that the box is powered and on the same network as this PC, or enter its IP by hand.

fixtures.name: Name
fixtures.universeHint: Each universe has 512 channels: the same address can be used on two universes. A USB interface drives only one (universe 0); beyond that you need an Art-Net bridge.
fixtures.addressHint: Leave the address empty to take the first free one ({n}).

errors.no_room: No room left in the DMX universe (512 channels).
errors.invalid_address: Invalid address: the fixture must fit between 1 and 512.

calibration.title: Keyboard aiming
calibration.finished: Last position confirmed. Go to the next step.
calibration.noPrevious: No previous desk to copy from for this moving head.
calibration.invertedOn: {axis}: direction reversed. The beam does not move.
calibration.invertedOff: {axis}: normal direction. The beam does not move.
calibration.taken: key used by a buzzer: use the button

help.validate: confirm and go to the next desk (or press the desk buzzer)
help.copy: copy the position of the previous desk of the same moving head

checks.physicalStop: A physical emergency stop cuts the machine's power and is within staff reach.
checks.timedRelay: The timed relay is set to 10 seconds at most.
checks.freezeTest: The simulated crash test passed (ticked automatically).
checks.siteRules: Fire detection and site rules were checked with the manager.

smoke.freezeQuestion: Did the smoke stop on its own within 10 seconds?
smoke.freezeFailed: Do not use the smoke: check the wiring and the timed relay setting, then run the test again.
smoke.freezeRunning: No frames are sent for 15 s. Watch the machine: the smoke must stop on its own within 10 s.
smoke.freezeAbort: The smoke does not stop: cut everything

willBeDisabled.no_device: Smoke will be saved as disabled: no smoke machine is configured.
willBeDisabled.checks_incomplete: Smoke will be saved as disabled: the safety checklist is not fully validated.

sync.local: This configuration is saved on this PC.
sync.saved: Configuration saved on the room account (backup copy on this PC).
sync.error: Back office unreachable: the configuration is kept on this PC and will be sent again at the next start or save.
sync.rejected: Configuration refused by the back office (too large or invalid): it is only kept on this PC.
sync.conflict: The configuration was changed from another station; the most recent version has been loaded.

profiles.title: Custom profiles and moving head direction
profiles.hint: Copy a generic profile to tune its channels: colour wheel (DMX value and colour of each slot), shutter, fixed values. Values are indicative: check the fixture manual. To use the copy, set its id as the fixture's profileId (JSON above).
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.inUse: Profile used by: {names}. Change the profileId of these fixtures (JSON above) before deleting it.
